original_defect: compact=716 raw=39 — compile_backend_report emitted a fixed 13-key schema, and the live gate compared len(json.dumps(compact_dict)) against raw text bytes, two different objects.
semantic_repair: payload_dumps() measures only the context-facing signal; provenance keys (raw_report_path, evidence_refs, compact_path, workspace) stay on the object for addressability but out of the size measurement. Consecutive duplicate lines collapse. Tiny reports mark passthrough. The 64-byte floor and the 8000 ceiling were NOT changed.
regressions_caught_and_fixed_by_me_at_me: The delegated lane's grok_bridge.py was HEAD-based and would have reverted 106 lines of pre-existing dirty work (the non-blocking poll() and the deadline-owning wait()). Its only real delta vs HEAD was compact_report, which the working tree already had, so that file was deliberately NOT merged.

The passthrough branch assigned raw_text verbatim to final_summary, leaking <think> reasoning blocks and tool payloads ({"tool":"shell","cmd":"cat /etc/passwd"}) into the compact record for any report under 256 bytes. Caught by test_grok_async.py::test_compact_report_does_not_dump_raw_trace. Fixed by routing passthrough through the same line filter (_summary(..., whole=True)).
no_test_weakened: No existing test was edited, skipped, or deleted. Both failures surfaced at merge were real regressions and were fixed in the implementation.
